name: context-menu
title: Context menu
description: The actions for one thing, at the pointer, on right-click or a long press.

props.name: trigger
props.description: What right-click opens the menu on. Rendered with `asChild`, so pass one element.

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal menus block the rest of the page while open.

props.name: onFocusOutside
props.description: Focus moved outside a non-modal menu; call `preventDefault()` to keep it open.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Deletes or removes: action/destructive/fg, and best placed last.

ContextMenuSub.description: A row that opens a submenu beside it (hover, →, or Enter). Other props, `ref` and `className` included, go to the submenu's panel (the Radix SubContent), not to the row.

ContextMenuSeparator.description: A 1px bg/muted rule between groups of rows.
